summary: Frontend-only retest focused on runtime error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)' in ServiciosHub. Loaded /, /servicios, /servicios/consultoria-empresarial, /servicios/terminales-punto-de-venta, /empresas/hoteles, /contacto with full reload and did client-side navigation. No webpack-dev-server overlay, no pageerror, no console errors captured. servicios-section renders with 3 pillars and 4 more-chips on / and /servicios. Guards (?? []) in ServiciosHub.jsx are correctly applied to pillars and more arrays.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiciosHub.jsx correctly guards pillars/more with ?? []. Consider also guarding SERVICIOS_HUB itself with a default (const HUB = SERVICIOS_HUB ?? {}) to survive future hot-reload orderings where the whole object could be temporarily undefined.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3: verified no runtime error in ServiciosHub across all 6 target routes and client-side nav (Home <-> pillar-0 TPV <-> Home). Zero pageerror/console errors captured with Playwright listeners.
rca of the issue: Original error occurred during webpack hot-update when ServiciosHub attempted to map over SERVICIOS_HUB.pillars/more before content.js finished re-evaluating. Fix: nullish-coalescing guards (SERVICIOS_HUB.pillars ?? []) and (SERVICIOS_HUB.more ?? []) prevent .map on undefined. Verified working.
